newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears investment proposals in mining.
newsitem.headline: India clears investment proposals in mining.

text.p: The Industry Ministry said on Thursday it had approved a proposal of South Africa's De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd for diamond prospecting in the central state of Madhya Pradesh.
The ministry said in a statement that De Beers has been allowed to form a joint venture in which it could have a 50 percent stake amounting to 525 million rupees.
The statement did not say who was the Indian partner in the venture.
The ministry also cleared a proposal by BHP Minerals Holdings Pty Ltd for setting up a $500,000 wholly-owned holding company for mineral prospecting.
Other mining proposals cleared included a 50:50 joint venture between ACC and Australia's CRA Exploration Ltd.
The joint venture would undertake prospecting of minerals including gold, silver, diamonds, bauxite, copper and lead.
